$comment: ADR-382 time-sliced abandoned stamping. stampPiecesPerTick: most BuildPiece specs one site-stamp pump places per tick (server + singleplayer, postSim gameplay.abandonedStamps). At the measured ~30-50 us per placed piece, 20 is ~0.6-1.0 ms/tick — inside the 2 ms chunk-load budget (ADR-379) with room for the chunk's own terrain gen. A site appears over ~3-10 ticks instead of one 4.5-9.2 ms hitch. The stamped result is identical whatever the value; only the timing moves. SITE_CHANCE stays in code (packages/gameplay/src/building/abandoned.ts) — this file only tunes the slice budget.
